text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's popularity continues to rise
with no
end in sight. The younger
student who's been
following her races
comes to speak with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She explains how it's thanks to Fuji
Kiseki that she
was able to realize
something important about
herself, but
Fuji Kiseki seems conflicted by this

confession...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки realizes it's not only this one
younger
student feeling limited by her
distance aptitude,
and she sets a new
goal for herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She declares that she'll take on and
conquer four
G1 races of varying
distances!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I throw my full support behind her.
When she
makes the grand
announcement about her plans,
the
world is thrown into a frenzy!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
